ledger.note: 1180: Rugard. 'After the Danish conquest, the princes moved their capital from Charenza to nearby Rugard'; 'Jaromar I resided from 1180 on the Rugard near Bergen.'
1235: Wolgast. 'In 1235, Wizlaw I gained half of the terra Wolgast, yet lost it to the Pomeranian dukes before 1250.' The page names no seller.
Before 1250 (page silent on the year): half of the terra Wolgast 'lost it to the Pomeranian dukes before 1250'. Entered at 1250.

1270: Schlawe. 'In 1270, as a result of his mother's claims, he came into the possession of the fiefdom of Schlawe' (the page also says Wizlaw II 'did not succeed in inheriting Schlawe-Stolp from his mother'). The page names no previous holder.

1275: Loitz. Wizlaw II 'gained the terra Loitz in 1275'; elsewhere 'After the extinction of the line of Detlef von Gadebusch in 1273 he inherited the region of Loitz'. Entered at 1275 (the 1273 date is the extinction).
1277: Schlawe sold. 'By in 1277 he had sold the estates and town to the margraves of Brandenburg.'
1325: the princely line ends and the vassalage with it; the Danish tie is not mentioned for the Pomeranian heirs.

1325: Wizlaw III dies. 'The Principality of Rügen was inherited by the Griffins ruling the Duchy of Pomerania, after the last Rugian prince Wizlaw III died in 1325' (infobox 'Princely line extinct; to Pomerania: 1325'; 'Acquired by Swedish Pomerania: 1648').

certainty.note: The page gives only 'the island of Rügen and the adjacent mainland' and a map caption; the circles are stand-ins, and the Ryck line of 1240 is the only boundary named.

notes:
Written 2026-10-25 for batch eu-09-x (1 page; budget 1-2). New state: Cliopatria has no Rügen row; the Pomerania dossier names principality-of-rugen as the counterpart of its 1325 gain.

SCOPE. 1168 to 1325 as in the lead and the infobox. The Rani were a tribe, not a state, so there is no predecessor. Wars named without a state-sized stake and not entered: the Battle of Bornhoved in 1227 (the Danes 'again lost all Wendish lands except for Rügen'), a Danish and Rani victory over the Pomeranian navy in the Bay of Greifswald in 1184, Rugian troops in Danish raids and conquests (1177, 1219, 1259), the destruction of Stralsund in 1249 and its siege in 1316 by Duke Eric I of Saxe-Lauenburg, and the two Rugian inheritance wars with Mecklenburg after 1325 (no dates). After the state: Danish attempts to reacquire Rügen (1625 offer) and Danish occupations (1675-79, 1715-21) belong to Swedish Pomerania.

SHAPES. Island circle 13.40E 54.42N 20 km; mainland circle 13.0E 54.25N 14 km; Wolgast 13.77E 54.05N 10 km; Loitz 13.12E 53.97N 12 km; Schlawe 16.68E 54.36N 14 km. Gazetteer names wanted: 'Bergen auf Rügen', 'Garz', 'Loitz', 'Wolgast', 'Slawno' (Schlawe).

NOT SETTLED. (1) No area; (2) 1273 or 1275 for Loitz; (3) the date Wolgast was lost ('before 1250'); (4) the 1240 Ryck boundary says where Pomerania began and not what changed; (5) the infobox's 'Acquired by Swedish Pomerania: 1648' is after the state.

COUNTERPARTS NEEDING DOSSIERS: none new (the Rani are a tribe).
